title: [dev-k] Autotune throws FATAL EXCEPTION
symptom: Autotune throws a FATAL EXCEPTION (NullPointerException) when navigating back to the main screen, causing a crash. The crash occurs intermittently and is not always reproducible.
cause: The crash may occur when a UI update is triggered from RX after the fragment/activity/dialog has been destroyed, leading to a null context or binding.
fix: Check context/_binding at the start of the function to avoid using null context.
evidence_quote: sometimes this happen when UI update is triggered from RX. Event is received after destroying fragment/activity/dialog. you can check context/_binding at start of function
